title: Measuring Neural-Network Robustness Under Adversarial Perturbation
subtitle: Experimental Evaluation of Model Behavior Under Gradient-Based Attacks
contribution: A reproducible robustness-evaluation harness for FGSM, PGD, and C&W that shows a measured 71.82% clean CIFAR-10 SmallCNN collapsing to 0.00% robust accuracy under PGD-20 at epsilon 8/255, while explicitly separating measured results from literature projections.
methods: Train/evaluate a compact CIFAR-10 classifier under a fixed seed and CPU budget.
Measure clean accuracy on the full CIFAR-10 test set.
Generate epsilon-bounded FGSM and PGD adversarial samples plus C&W L2 samples.
Measure robust accuracy on the committed attack subset.
Emit structured evidence and CI robustness-gate logic.
evidence: Cited Python 3.12 CI: 112 passed; 32.22% statement coverage, same test job.
Separate committed measurement 1282d78c42cfcd6a6ecd70b711d95058cb3ad7b0, September 3, 2026: SmallCNN has 1,117,354 parameters, 6 CPU epochs, seed 42; clean evaluation uses 10,000 images.
Actual attack subset: 1,024 samples (requested 1,000). FGSM robust accuracy 3.32%; PGD-20 0.00% at epsilon 8/255 and step 2/255; C&W-L2 4.20% (c=1, 100 steps).
Source: results/cifar10_smallcnn_real.json. The cited October CI robustness job was skipped; these historical model measurements were not rerun locally.
limitations: This repository measures vulnerability; it does not make a model robust.
Robust-accuracy attacks use a 1,024-sample subset, not the full 10,000 test set.
No AutoAttack, black-box transfer, or certified-robustness result is established.
results/cifar10_resnet18_benchmark.json is explicitly literature-projected/synthetic and must not be presented as measured.
Torch/dataset availability blocks a fresh model reproduction; CI test passing is separate from the historical robustness experiment.
reproduction: Install the documented development dependencies; run python -m pytest tests/ -q. Use the cited job configuration when reproducing coverage.
Benchmark data, adapters and environment requirements are separate; consult poster/13_reproducibility.md and the claim ledger.
